headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Chicago White Sox in a thrilling 9-8 victory, with Eugenio Suárez leading the Reds' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing win over the Miami Marlins, with a final score of 13-1, led by Rafael Flores Jr.'s standout performance.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Matt Chapman has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain, while Trevor McDonald was also moved to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. Garrett Whitlock was placed on the 15-day injured list with right elbow inflammation, and James Outman is on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. Endy Rodríguez is on the 10-day injured list with left hip inflammation, and Riley Greene is on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain.

The Baltimore Orioles acquired Harold Rivas in a trade with the Boston Red Sox, and the Kansas City Royals received Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Chicago White Sox in a thrilling 9-8 victory. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Marlins in Dominant 13-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing win over the Miami Marlins, with a final score of 13-1. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' offense with a standout performance, collecting 2 hits, 2 home runs, and 6 RBIs in 5 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Mariners Take Down Yankees in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Weston Wilson led the Mariners' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Matt Chapman Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants third baseman Matt Chapman has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. He was previously on the 10-day injured list.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
